question.worked_solution:
We rearrange the terms so that the like terms, $6a$ and $-2a$, are together.

$$
\eqalign{
		6a+1-2a &= \[5pt]
		\underbrace{6a-2a}_{a \textrm{ terms}}+ 1	&
	}
$$

Then, we combine the like terms: 

$$
\eqalign{
		\underbrace{6a-2a}+ 1 &= \[5pt]
		(6-2)a + 1 &=\[5pt]
		4a + 1&		
	}
$$
